stock.description: Giant Biogene Holding Co., Ltd. operates as an investment holding entity, primarily engaged in the research, development, production, and sale of beauty and wellness products based on bioactive materials throughout the People's Republic of China. The company also manufactures functional foods leveraging rare ginsenosides technology and provides medical devices. Its diverse product range, which includes specialized skincare, medical dressings, and nutritional supplements, is marketed predominantly under brand names such as Comfy, Collgene, Keyu, Kehen, Kefuping, Leeyen, SKIGIN, and Shengan. Established in 2000, Giant Biogene Holding Co., Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Xi'an, PRC.
